The tools are free to use for preparing images that you have permission to use and print. You are responsible for copyright, necessary permissions and complying with laws applicable to your use.

Review output before printing

PDF dimensions are calculated using standard units, but paper results depend on printer settings, paper, ink and image quality. Color matching and compliance with official document photo rules are not guaranteed. Test one sheet before printing a batch. Do not rely on these tools for safety-critical engineering or medical measurements.
